name: autosoc-monorepo
description: AutoSOC Agentic AI-Driven Autonomous Security Operations Center

scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn autosoc_api.main:app --reload
scripts.lint:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check .
scripts.format:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff format .
scripts.typecheck:api: cd apps/api && uv run mypy src
scripts.verify:all: pnpm lint:all && pnpm typecheck:web && pnpm typecheck:api && pnpm test:all
